meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 当用户要求执行、运行或实施一个已有计划时,Claude 会变成“总调度”:自己不直接动手,而是把工作拆成阶段、派“实施”子代理执行;每阶段之后还会派“验证”“反模式”“代码质量”等子代理检查,全部通过才提交代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“执行”“运行”“实施”等字眼,请 Claude 按某个计划推进时触发——尤其是该计划由 make-plan 生成时。

say.text: 请执行这份实施方案,按阶段推进。
say.note: Claude 会拆成阶段,派子代理逐步执行。

say.text: 运行这个计划,每完成一阶段先验证再继续。
say.note: 每阶段都会先跑验证清单再前进。

say.text: 把 make-plan 生成的计划落地,提交前做代码质量检查。
say.note: 会派代码质量子代理审查变更后再提交。

howto.what_en: When asked to execute a plan, Claude acts as orchestrator: it splits the work into phases and deploys subagents. After each phase it dispatches verification, anti-pattern, and code-quality reviewers; commits happen only after checks pass.
howto.when_en: Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Please execute this implementation plan, phase by phase.
say_en.note: Subagents will be deployed to work through each phase.

say_en.text: Run this plan; verify each phase before moving on.
say_en.note: Each phase runs a verification checklist first.

say_en.text: Carry out the plan from make-plan; do a code quality check before commit.
say_en.note: A code quality subagent reviews changes before any commit.
